description: Admin only. Copy the tenant's Pipedrive deals into CallPilotAI's own database (the deal mirror), so row and location rules can apply to deals. mode 'full' reads every deal (first import, and marks deals deleted in Pipedrive); mode 'since' reads only deals changed since `since` (ISO time; default: last run). Pipedrive stays the leading system — this never writes to Pipedrive.

mode.description: full reads every deal; since reads only deals changed since the given time

since.description: ISO time for mode 'since'. Default: the last sync.

name: sync_pipedrive_deals
